reviews: It’s an amazing place for seafood lovers and I recommend you to visit especially if you like your sea food grilled
The place is so beautiful and clean 💙✨

The restaurant is very big and the staff were welcoming and the service was fast. The Shari grilled was delicious. The grill shrimps was amazing and tasty never has the same flavor elsewhere but the nashif shrimp lack flavors I did not like it
Was super excited to have fish in Bahrain but my experience was not up to the excitement expectations. Fish was dry and without any flavor

Not sure I'd call it a specialized coffee spot, but their signature coffee did taste really good to me. The downside? The price - 1.8 feels like a rip-off given the small portion, especially with competitors offering better value. Good taste, but I wouldn't go back."

Me and my friend went to the branch in busaiteen, we waited for 45 minutes, one guy took our order and never came back. And they all kept on ignoring us while going to the other cars nearby, regardless of us calling multiple times, no one came to check or even confirm with us that our order was placed. It was disappointing considering we loved this branch, it was very disrespectful

Yummmm I am in love with the crispy shrimp salad 1000/10😍😍 The mushroom burger was nice too 7/10 Crispy chicken tower was great but too sauce I would prefer to have it with less sauce 8/10 Special thanks to Micheal was very friendly and helpful, he makes sure to serve us the food the way we like and brought extra sauce so we can enjoy our salad on every bite👏🏻 Overall, It was a really good experience and I am going again to try the rest of the menu❤️!

A fantastic spot for lunch with a spacious seating area both indoors and outdoors, surrounded by lush greenery. The place offers a charming ambiance with unique touches like pottery displays and traditional decorations. A well-maintained small zoo adds to the experience, where the soothing sounds of chirping birds create a delightful atmosphere.

Very bad service and staff unprofessional they give us the order messy and when we request to fix it he staff a manager was very rude and refuse they state the order service like this !!!! Staff name Ken Manger jaffer

Have visited Jasmi’s after a long long time and keeping the same taste and expectations in mind I was totally disappointed. The patty and the sauce doesn’t taste like how it used to be. Very dry. Sad to see a famous brand lose its reputation. The staff and ambiance was great. Accepts card, cash and major digital wallets. I don’t think I will be visiting again.

I have tried so many places but this place is very professional to listen to their customers and always make the order as per customer requirement they are amazing their food is amazing the only problem is there is no parking but if you take a taxi that will be the best way to go there highly recommended must try place one of the greatest Sharma in the kingdom I love it and I always take my family members here as well also my friends the... best Shawarma in the kingdom
Bad service the staff was shouting on us

The worst service I have ever experienced from KFC. The staff were unprofessional, the service was extremely bad, and there was no proper attention to customers. This experience was very disappointing and far below the standards expected from a brand like KFC. I hope the management takes this seriously and improves the customer experience in this branch.

This is a nice and quiet coffee place at Zallaq to spend a relaxing time with friends. The coffee choices are very good, and the other drinks are alright too. The staff are nice. Not many people frequent during the weekdays. There are mostly students working on study projects or doing homework there. Parking is usually available at Gravity Village.

Such varierty of perfectly blended coffees and mocktails The interior decor is fascinating, very simple yet elegant. I love the tree in the Cafe. It feels like a tribute to the tree of life. The outdoor seating is also good. The one place Im OK with for not having a drive thru. All must go in and admire the interior decor.

Easy access, good location, ample parking. A large selection of food, service ok. However, there is no ongoing cleaning of the tables. Unfortunately, not all customers clean up after themselves, and the service can be found only behind the sales counter.

Excellent location, for grab and go... For dine in it has to much food smell.. Like you can't eat and go for work or meeting afterward... Maybe problem with ventilation... If the weather is good and u are lucky.. Outdoor is a good choice

Food was good. But the prices were much much too high for the location and setting of this establishment. Charging prices for Manama restaurants when it’s hidden behind a prison and located in the midst of warehouses etc. such a shame. A real shame.

The food was great.i have eaten hardees for the 1st time ever! The offer was great for 1.3 meal with 2 burgers + fries + drink. It's good to see other brands putting competing prices so we can enjoy meals

I was quite disappointed with the atmosphere at this place. One of the female employees frequently sits outside with a group of guys, laughing and talking loudly for long periods of time. This behavior is extremely unprofessional and creates a noisy and uncomfortable environment for customers. What’s even worse is that she openly talks with them about other customers who visit the shop, which is highly inappropriate and unprofessional. For people who come to study or relax, it’s nearly impossible to concentrate because of the noise and lack of respect. Such conduct reflects very poorly on the shop’s image and professionalism.
I got my pan pizza undercooked I was eating raw dough I had to throw it since I don't have an oven to cook it all the way through

My rating for this cake is average. I expected the pistachio flavor to be stronger and more noticeable, but unfortunately it was quite mild, even though the color was clear. On the other hand, the chocolate flavor was more dominant. Overall, this experience didn’t meet my expectations, especially since I usually order from you from time to time. I also feel that the price is high compared to the quality of this cake. I hope to see improvement in the future.

The food at Blue Beach Restaurant is actually good, but the service completely ruins the experience. They take a very long time to serve, and the staff are rude and unresponsive. Even if you call someone, they don’t come right away. Good food, but very poor service.
Once a place of great value, now an overpriced cost cutting one (waited 1 hour)

Tried broasted chicken and hummus, chicken were soft and tasty and hummus was amazing, it is super delicious. I had super avocado as a drink, it is really super with the nuts and fruits. It is been awhile since I tried Bird Palace food and will never ever let it pass that too long to order again. Great food and lovely avocado juice. Will definitely order again and again soon. Thank you Bird Palace team.

A different vibe compared to the old days where the place was jam packed and I much prefer it for that! Quiet, with surpise animal friends popping in and around you. Love the scenery and the gym which still contains relic nautilus next generation equipment, which beats most if not all new equipment, is great to see! I come here to unwind and have a walk and use the gym.

I have read a review on google about The Country club. It was bad. But me and my wife decided to still try it out since we came year for the past 19 years. My review… pathetic!!! Poor service, ordered lunch, they bring the wrong food. And there were only 5 people in the restaurant, we were the only ones ordered food. Waiter never came to ask is anything, I have to get up, searching for him, and still no one in sight. It is a shame. No management on duty. You will never see this South African again STAY AWAY!!!!

Can someone explain me from the Ministry WHY THIS PLACE IS STILL RUNNING? service is zero, staff is zero,non of the staff speak English, food quality is very bad, can you imagine they serve soup with out any accopainment and when I asked for bread they bought me 2 pieces white slice bread and then they charge me 2 bd for it, prices are sky high. The place just need to be shut down big time con. Im surely going to raise this issue to higher authorities because is unacceptable. Plus, in the menu they never mention items they service all they write is OPEN FOOD, OPEN BEVERAGES" now what is that suppose to mean? What a disappointment
Big place with various options to choose from. Prices are very suitable but the location does not help much when it comes to taking your order.

The ambience is excellent, with a relaxing outdoor cabana setup overlooking the sea. Facilities are spotless, and even the washrooms are thoughtfully maintained with a pleasant scent. Superb food quality. The staff are consistently kind and helpful, making the entire experience feel welcoming and memorable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a serene dining escape.

The place is a lil difficult to find especially if it's dark. The place has ample parking. The place is great to sit and have quality time. Shesha is good and the food is good aswell. It's has both indoor and outdoor seating facing the sea. The service can become a negative point here as even though there is sufficient staffing they don't serve too well. They do accept all major credit and debit cards. Washrooms are clean. Staff Is very polite. They do not serve alcohol.

I thought the point of fast food was it being fast. This is the 2nd time that there would be no one on the counter and you can hear the staff (girls) chatting in the back and you have to raise your voice for them to hear and attend to you.

I visited this branch today at around 3:49 PM, and unfortunately, the overall cleanliness did not meet expectations. Many of the tables were left uncleared, with leftover food and chicken pieces, which created an unpleasant dining environment. I kindly ask the management to place more attention on maintaining cleanliness, especially during operating hours, as it plays a major role in the overall customer experience. I hope this can be improved moving forward.

Charcoal grilled burgers (single patty) for 1 BD. I can’t complain. The smell and the taste of the soft bun and patty is so worth the visit after an evening of drinking. I love hole in the walls and I really enjoy Jan Burger for their low key, cheap and delicious hamburgers and chicken burgers.
The place was really clean and the staff name Toni was so nice and friendly and accommodating. Best staff here in Zayed town the beauty in her face make us energy

One of the best places to study . The atmosphere is amazing from the lights to the low level of music .everything is perfect. And the staff are so friendly and are one of best compared to other branches, they always have a smile on their faces and give everyone a warm welcome. Definitely would recommend this place either for studying or just a coffee chat
It's one of the most famous bakreys science I born, they really serve good quality pastrys and what I don't like is the lack of parking...
The shawarma were hard and expensive there quality wasn't nice

Decent, tasty shawarma for a good price. Plenty of food for your money. The grill options like kebabs weren’t available later on a weeknight for some reason. Friendly and attentive staff. It was close to empty around 7:30pm. The juices were delicious; try the sexy special.

This legendary shawarma spot has been serving shawarmas for over 30 years! Their malghoom is also must try and you need to dine in to experience it to the fullest. Each table will have its own Hot sauce and Tahina which can be poured in to the Malghoom for each bite. They also give you pickled cucumbers as a side dish. This is a must try shawarma spot if you are in Bahrain. Prices are very reasonable. Parking can be a little tricky during weekend!
